body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics unveiled its 24-,30-inch LED-backlit LCD monitors during KES(Korea Electronics Show) 2007, which feature 123% of color reproduction. It is expected to be released in November for Korea market and in October for Europe market. Suggested price is around 3,000,000(KRW) for 24-inch and around 5,000,000(KRW) for 30-inch.
